import sys

class AK375:
    def evaluate(self, length, inputStr):
        nestedSegments = []
        mainString = []
        maxSegmentLength = 0
        totalSegments = 0

        i = 0
        while i < length:
            c = inputStr[i]
            if c == '(':
                nestedSegments.append('_')
                j = i + 1
                while j < length and inputStr[j] != ')':
                    nestedSegments.append(inputStr[j])
                    j += 1
                i = j
            elif c == ')':
                mainString.append('_')
            else:
                mainString.append(c)
            i += 1

        nestedParts = ''.join(nestedSegments).split('_')
        nestedList = [part for part in nestedParts if part]
        totalSegments = len(nestedList)

        mainParts = ''.join(mainString).split('_')
        for p in mainParts:
            if len(p) > maxSegmentLength:
                maxSegmentLength = len(p)

        return f"{maxSegmentLength} {totalSegments}"

def main():
    input_lines = sys.stdin.read().split()
    index = 0
    while index < len(input_lines):
        n = int(input_lines[index])
        index += 1
        s = input_lines[index]
        index += 1
        result = AK375().evaluate(n, s)
        print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
